description:
About the job

About Turn




Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.




About the Role




We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.

You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.




What You'll Do




Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).
Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.
Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.
Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.
Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).
Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.




What You'll Need




Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.
Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.
Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).
Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).
CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.
A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.
Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.

This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.




Nice to Have




Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.
Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.
Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).
Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.
Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.




Perks & Compensation




Competitive salary (base range shared early in the process)
Major medical health insurance
Paid time off
Remote work with in-office training and ocasional in-person meetings (Mexico City)

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Total Consumer Electronics is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' portfolio, contributing to improvements in the experience for customers and creating weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors, acting as main point of contact for them.

You will provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

As a Brand Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include

Online marketing: improve product page data, develop marketing and merchandising plans, improve experience onsite, generate traffic and sales; Vendor management: grow catalog to sell on Amazon, identify and resolve pricing issues; In-stock management: tracking purchase orders and work with vendors automation.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in process improvement
 Experience managing large amounts of data


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Books Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Vendor Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after the brands´ product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed weekly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

A day in the life

As a Vendor Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include


 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: focusing on improving inputs, help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.

We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Growth & Customer Success Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Growth & Client Success Specialist en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro le pone tecnología al sueño de miles de empresas y emprendedores de belleza, salud y bienestar en Latinoamérica, y vamos por millones. Gestionamos más de 100 millones de citas, con clientes que aumentan sus ingresos 82% en promedio. Respaldo de Y Combinator, Serie B de US$35M y tecnología propia de IA. Nuestro negocio de pagos (POS y online) crece fuerte y queremos que cada comercio le saque el máximo provecho.




📍 Modalidad presencial / híbrida – base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




Tu desafío: Hacer crecer el uso de nuestros medios de pago dentro de la cartera de comercios que ya son clientes (modelo LAND/EXPAND). No es cazar clientes nuevos: es que los que ya tenemos transaccionen más con nosotros.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor, con revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant.

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%.

• Diagnosticar la fricción (técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y resolver o escalar los obstáculos de procesamiento.

• Anti-arbitraje: detectar comercios que usan el split de boleta pero procesan la tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y actuar sobre ello.

• Intervenir cuando las cuentas caen bajo el umbral o muestran señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Recibir los comercios recién vendidos/activados y asumir la relación de crecimiento, coordinando con los hunters sin competir en la venta.

• Escalar necesidades de producto al PM.

• Alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requerimientos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

description:
About the job

ATQLeads builds GTM systems for B2B companies that are done waiting on agencies and tired of the cost of full-time hires. We sit between the two: a network of vetted GTM operators who embed directly inside client teams — inside their tools, their Slack, their stack — and deliver against outcomes, not hours. We don't sell retainers. We deploy capacity. Operators are part of the company. If you want to own real work, operate inside real companies, and be compensated like a partner rather than a contractor, this is where you belong.




Role Overview

The GTM Engineer is the engine builder at the core of every ATQ Squad engagement.

Strategy without a GTME stays theoretical. Campaigns stay manual. Data stays fragmented. Pipeline stays unpredictable. The GTME is the person who turns direction into operational machinery and then keeps that machinery running. You won't be assigned tickets. You'll be given a GTM problem, a client stack, and a capacity commitment. Your job is to build the system that solves it, own its reliability, and push it forward without being asked.




What You'll Do




Outbound, Inbound and Pipeline Generation Engine — multi-channel sequences across email, LinkedIn, phone, and video, with sequence logic appropriate to each channel. Sending infrastructure and deliverability management: domain warmup, sender rotation, content variation, blacklist monitoring. Inbound capture via webhooks from forms, webinars, intent feeds, and website behavior. Product-led activation flows (signup → first key product action → conversion trigger) when product event data is available.




Data and Enrichment System — lead sourcing, TAM mapping, waterfall enrichment across multiple data sources, segmentation, and signal-based targeting using firmographic, technographic, hiring, funding, intent, and behavioral signals. Custom signals built from any data source, not only pre-built intent feeds. Composite scoring models that combine multiple signals. Signal expiration and refresh cadence management per source.




Automation and Workflow Layer — end-to-end workflows across Clay (multi-source tables, formula columns, Claygent prompts), Make/n8n (multi-step logic, error handling, retries, webhooks), Apify, and CRM. API and webhook integrations as the default approach, including when native integrations exist. LLM API calls (Claygent, OpenAI, Anthropic) integrated into production workflows for enrichment, classification, or copy generation. Reusable modules (Clay Functions, Make sub-scenarios) so logic is not duplicated across tables. Python and pandas for data work no-code tools cannot handle.




Conversion Infrastructure — reply handling logic, meeting routing and scheduling flows, CRM hygiene (HubSpot, Zoho, or Salesforce), and tracking and attribution infrastructure built in at system setup, not added afterward. Dashboards that show conversion rates and volume at each funnel step. Signal source mapped to conversion outcome, so you can identify the step with the largest performance gap and fix it there.




Three Phases of Execution

Your work runs in three modes depending on where the engagement is:




Foundation — build the initial outbound and data infrastructure, translate the GTM Strategist's ICP into Clay filter logic, configure CRM workflows, and establish the reporting layer. Define and instrument the metrics needed to evaluate system performance before launch. Deliverable: one functional GTM engine ready to generate pipeline, with monitoring at each step and documentation alongside the build — handoff doc, README, Loom walkthrough.




Ongoing — launch and manage campaigns, enrich and refresh lead lists, monitor deliverability, handle replies, and maintain CRM accuracy (deals progress through stages, are moved, deduplicated, and closed when stale). Calculate conversion rates at each funnel step (open, reply, positive reply, meeting set, show). Deliverable: consistent campaign execution and pipeline flow.




Optimization — A/B test messaging, targeting logic, and conversion paths. Prioritize improvements at the funnel step with the largest gap between current performance and benchmark, not by stakeholder requests. Expand into new segments and channels once the existing system delivers consistently. Reduce manual steps systematically by automating any step still requiring human action. Refine ICP using actual response and conversion data, not only the initial hypothesis. Deliverable: improving efficiency and scaling pipeline generation.




Cross-Functional Collaboration

You depend on inputs to do your job well: ICP definition and positioning from the GTM Strategist, offer clarity and CRM access from the client, and clean data from your enrichment sources. Weak inputs reduce output efficiency, so you'll need to be direct about what you need and when. Manage upstream dependencies actively: report data quality issues, flag missing Strategist inputs, and request clarification when a brief lacks the inputs needed for accurate delivery.

You'll work closely with sales, marketing, and growth ops teams as a peer. No jargon. No vendor distance. You're inside the operation. You communicate directly with clients without a project manager intermediary.




Strategic Ownership




After onboarding, you generate your own ideas. You don't wait for a brief. You diagnose bottlenecks early — identify which step of the system is causing performance issues (copy, list quality, deliverability, routing, or timing) and resolve at that step. You prioritize by revenue impact and build experiments that compound. You think like an operator: what's the highest-leverage thing to ship this week?




You build systems that continue functioning after you leave the engagement, with no required maintenance from the original builder. A track record of at least one shipped system still running at a previous engagement after you left is the bar.

title: Sales & Account Manager
description:
About the job

🚀 Sales & Account Manager | Ventas Consultivas B2B Tech




En Anyness estamos buscando a nuestro próximo Sales & Account Manager, una persona comercial, consultiva y orientada a resultados, que nos ayude a construir relaciones sólidas con clientes y a convertir necesidades de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas de alto valor.




Buscamos a alguien que disfrute conversar con clientes, hacer las preguntas correctas, entender sus retos operativos y detectar oportunidades donde la tecnología, la inteligencia artificial, la automatización y los servicios digitales puedan generar impacto real.




¿Qué harás?




Serás responsable de acompañar al cliente durante todo el proceso comercial: desde el primer acercamiento y discovery, hasta la construcción de propuestas, negociación, cierre, renovación y seguimiento postventa.




Más que vender productos, buscamos que puedas entender el contexto del cliente, identificar sus dolores de negocio y conectar esas necesidades con soluciones de valor.




Tus principales responsabilidades serán:




✅ Gestionar y desarrollar cuentas medianas y corporativas dentro de Anyness.

✅ Atender y calificar leads generados por marketing, referidos, eventos o campañas.

✅ Prospectar nuevas oportunidades comerciales alineadas al mercado objetivo.

✅ Ejecutar reuniones de discovery para entender necesidades de negocio, operación y tecnología.

✅ Identificar oportunidades de IA, automatización, licenciamiento, servicios administrados y soluciones digitales.

✅ Construir propuestas comerciales claras, consultivas y alineadas al valor que podemos generar.

✅ Coordinarte con áreas internas para validar alcances, soluciones, tiempos y condiciones comerciales.

✅ Negociar condiciones comerciales y dar seguimiento hasta el cierre.

✅ Identificar oportunidades de renovación, expansión, venta cruzada y nuevos servicios.

✅ Mantener actualizado el pipeline comercial y CRM.

✅ Acompañar la experiencia del cliente después del cierre, asegurando seguimiento y continuidad.




¿Qué buscamos?




Nos encantaría conocerte si tienes:




• Experiencia de +3 años en ventas consultivas B2B, account management, desarrollo de negocio o gestión de cuentas.

• Experiencia deseable en empresas de tecnología, SaaS, servicios administrados, licenciamiento, cloud, ciberseguridad, Microsoft o soluciones digitales.

• Experiencia atendiendo clientes medianos, corporativos o enterprise.

• Capacidad para entender retos de negocio y traducirlos en oportunidades comerciales.

• Habilidad para hacer discovery, detectar necesidades y construir propuestas de valor.

• Facilidad para prospectar, dar seguimiento, negociar y cerrar oportunidades.

• Comunicación clara, profesional y consultiva.

• Organización y disciplina para gestionar pipeline, CRM y seguimiento comercial.

• Experiencia usando CRM como Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive o similares.

• Curiosidad por tecnología, inteligencia artificial, automatización y transformación digital.




Este rol es para ti si…




Te gusta vender, pero no solo por vender.

Te interesa entender al cliente, detectar oportunidades reales, construir relaciones de largo plazo y acompañar el crecimiento de una cuenta.

Buscamos a alguien con hambre comercial, criterio, seguimiento, visión de negocio y gusto por las ventas consultivas.




Una persona que sepa escuchar, conectar ideas, negociar con estrategia y generar confianza con clientes.




Lo que ofrecemos




• Sueldo base competitivo: $18,000 - $22,000 brutos mensuales

• Esquema de comisiones

• Oportunidad de crecimiento en una empresa de tecnología e inteligencia artificial

• Exposición a soluciones de IA, Microsoft, automatización y servicios digitales

• Trabajo cercano con dirección y equipos estratégicos

• Prestaciones superiores a la ley

• Modalidad híbrida en Zapopan, Jalisco

• 2 días home office / 3 días presencial

• Oficinas en Av. Naciones Unidas




En Anyness creemos que vender tecnología no se trata solo de cerrar oportunidades, sino de escuchar, entender, conectar y generar valor real para nuestros clientes.




Stop talking about AI. Start using it.

Ingeniero de Software Full-Stack Senior (Vue + Laravel)

Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.




Lo que ofrecemos

100% remoto.
Honorarios entre $65,000 y $80,000 brutos, acordes a tu experiencia.
Bono por objetivos ligado a que tu producto llegue a producción y cobre.
Impacto directo: lo que construyes lo usan miles de abogados y empresas desde el día uno.
Un plan 2030 real, con productos definidos y financiamiento propio, del que tu trabajo es pieza central.




Cómo aplicar

Envía tu CV junto con lo siguiente (las aplicaciones que no incluyan estos puntos no avanzan en el proceso):

Describe un sistema que hayas construido o mantenido tú y que esté (o haya estado) en producción: stack, escala de datos y usuarios, y cuál fue tu responsabilidad concreta.
In English (a couple of paragraphs): tell us about a time you built a product or process from scratch. What did not exist before, what did you set up, and what did it look like 6 months later?
Tu disponibilidad de inicio.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

About Alibaba.com

Alibaba.com is one of the world’s leading B2B e-commerce platforms, connecting businesses around the globe and helping small and medium-sized enterprises grow through digital trade.

We are expanding our sales team in Mexico City and looking for ambitious, resilient, and results-driven sales professionals to help grow our business across the Americas, with a strong focus on the United States.




About the Role

As a Bilingual Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for identifying and contacting potential business customers, qualifying their needs, and booking demos for our US-based sales team.

This is a high-volume outbound calling role. You will spend most of your day calling business owners and decision-makers, introducing Alibaba.com, qualifying interest, and creating qualified sales opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who is energized by phone-based sales, comfortable with rejection, and motivated by daily activity targets, pipeline creation, and performance-based results.




What You Will Do

• Make high-volume outbound calls to potential business customers, primarily in the US market.

• Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce Alibaba.com and identify potential sellers.

• Qualify leads based on business needs, interest level, and fit for Alibaba.com membership.

• Book qualified demos and meetings for the US sales closing team.

• Follow up consistently through phone, email, and other approved outreach channels.

• Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, lead status, and next steps.

• Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and demo show-up rates.

• Meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly targets for outbound activity, qualified leads, and booked demos.




What We Are Looking For

• Previous experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, business development, or call center sales.

• Strong comfort with making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

• English proficiency at B2 level or above; C1 preferred.

• Ability to speak professionally and confidently with US-based business owners and decision-makers.

• Resilient, persistent, and motivated by targets and performance metrics.

• Strong listening skills and ability to quickly identify customer needs.

• Organized and disciplined in tracking follow-ups and sales activity.

• Experience selling to SMBs, merchants, manufacturers, exporters, distributors, or business owners is a plus.

• Interest in e-commerce, international trade, or digital business is a plus.







What Success Looks Like

• You consistently complete daily outbound call targets.

• You generate qualified leads and book demos for the US sales team.

• Your booked demos have strong show-up and conversion quality.

• You are comfortable hearing “no” often and continuing with energy and professionalism.

• You improve your pitch, objection handling, and qualification skills over time.




Why Join Us

• Build international B2B sales experience with customers across the Americas.

• Work with Alibaba.com, a globally recognized B2B e-commerce platform.

• Develop outbound sales, lead generation, and business development skills.

• Join a growing Mexico City team supporting expansion in the US market.

• Be part of a performance-driven environment where results and ownership are recognized.

description:
About the job

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una empresa de HR tech con desarrollo en plataforma, nuestra plataforma ayuda a las compañías a enriquecer y potenciar sus procesos de evaluación y formación para colaboradores. Lo logramos a través de módulos especializados que incluyen: Edición y visualización de objetivos (con OKR's), evaluación de cumplimiento de metas y programación de rutas de aprendizaje enfocadas en mejorar habilidades y competencias.

Nuestro objetivo es impulsar el crecimiento profesional de los colaboradores, permitiéndoles desarrollarse junto con la empresa y crear equipos de alto desempeño.

En Lapzo, trabajamos para crear culturas de aprendizaje continuo, maximizando el potencial humano dentro de las organizaciones.

Por ello, valoramos profundamente:

La autogestión y la adaptabilidad.
La comunicación y la colaboración efectiva.
La orientación a resultados, la resolución de problemas y, sobre todo, la orientación al cliente.

Buscamos un Sales Development Representative (SDR) que no solo quiera generar leads, sino que quiera construir pipeline estratégico, dominar el outbound y convertirse en un referente comercial dentro de la organización.

Resumen de la posición:




El Sales Development Representative (SDR) será responsable de generar oportunidades calificadas (SQLs) para el equipo comercial de Lapzo, a través de prospección outbound estratégica en el segmento B2B SaaS.

Su enfoque principal será construir pipeline de calidad mediante investigación, contacto multicanal (LinkedIn, llamadas en frío, email) y una correcta calificación de prospectos, asegurando que las oportunidades entregadas tengan alto potencial real de conversión.




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Construir listas inteligentes: Investigarás y construirás listas de prospectos potenciales utilizando herramientas como LinkedIn, Apollo y Masleads, identificando perfiles de decisores alineados con el ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) de Lapzo.
Ejecutar prospección multicanal diaria: Realizarás llamadas en frío, enviarás correos electrónicos personalizados y ejecutarás otras formas de contacto para captar leads, dedicando el 80% de tu tiempo a esta actividad.
Calificar con criterio: Calificarás leads para determinar si representan una oportunidad viable para Lapzo, evaluando su interés, necesidad, presupuesto y timing a través de conversaciones exploratorias estructuradas.
Agendar reuniones con decisores reales: Ayudarás a los clientes potenciales a comprender el valor de la plataforma Lapzo, comunicando beneficios clave de forma clara y adaptada al contexto e industria de cada prospecto, y agendarás reuniones con los perfiles adecuados.
Mantener CRM impecable: Mantendrás y actualizarás de forma rigurosa la información en HubSpot, registrando interacciones, estados de los leads y seguimientos para garantizar visibilidad y trazabilidad en el pipeline de ventas.
Analizar métricas y mejorar conversiones: Colaborarás estrechamente con los Sales Development Executives para asegurar una transición fluida de los prospectos calificados, documentando contexto relevante para maximizar la probabilidad de cierre, y analizarás tus propias métricas para identificar áreas de mejora.




Postúlate si:

Tienes 1 a 2 años de experiencia en ventas, prospección o atención al cliente, con exposición a entornos B2B.
Tienes experiencia comprobable en outbound: cold calling, email y LinkedIn (aunque sea en etapas tempranas de tu carrera, tienes la actitud para aprender y ejecutar).
Te sientes cómodo hablando con decisores y perfiles de nivel gerencial o directivo, y no te intimida el rechazo.
Trabajas por métricas y entiendes la importancia de medir tu desempeño (contact rate, reply rate, show rate, SQL rate).

description:
About the job

Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.




We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-makin

g.Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.




Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.




You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.




We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 




What do we need

We are seeking a Product Manager to drive feature delivery, product quality, and continuous improvement for scientific solutions built on Dotmatics LUMA, a next-generation, multi-tenant, AI-powered data management and workflow automation platform for multimodal scientific discovery.




In this role, you will partner closely with Application Scientists, engineering, UX, and go-to-market teams to deliver high-quality enhancements and user-centric product features. You will help shape how scientists interact with modern data and workflow systems by owning problem spaces, defining clear requirements, and ensuring that work moves effectively from concept to production




In this role you will get to:

Identify, prioritize, and help resolve user-facing issues and functional challenges, incorporating feedback to improve product usability and performance.
Test and refine ideas through prototypes, usability feedback, and light experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to inform iterative improvements.
Analyze product usage data, customer insights, and market signals to support prioritization and guide product decisions.
Write clear, actionable user stories and feature requirements that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
Engage regularly with customer-facing teams to understand user workflows and pain points, applying these insights to daily product decisions.
Support UX/UI partners by reviewing wireframes and design concepts, ensuring alignment with product standards and design patterns.
Independently own delivery of moderately complex features from scoping through release, and support larger initiatives with guidance from senior PMs.
Collaborate with engineering, QA, design, and GTM partners to align timelines, clarify requirements, and drive smooth execution.
Incorporate customer feedback into product decisions, prioritizing enhancements that address meaningful user needs.
Contribute to product strategy discussions by sharing insights, data, and learnings from your feature areas to support roadmap development.




We are looking for people who have 4+ years of SaaS Product Management or related experience and hold a degree or higher in biology. You will bring a strong analytical skills and ability to break down moderately complex problems and explain concepts clearly. This role requires advanced proficiency in English, including the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly in writing and speech, given the level of client interaction and cross-functional leadership involved.




The key skills we are looking for: 

Familiarity with UX tools (e.g., Figma) and ability to partner effectively with design to support intuitive user flows.
Scientific or technical product domain, with the ability to independently apply skills across varied situations.
Demonstrated success contributing to scientific data platforms, workflow tools, ETL, APIs, or data modeling.
Strong fluency in Agile methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence), with experience driving user stories from backlog to production.
Strength in writing clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
Ability to manage trade-offs, navigate ambiguity, and adapt to evolving priorities.




You may also have: 

Passion for improving user experience and elevating product quality through continuous iteration.
Experience integrating instruments, managing data ingestion pipelines, or working with multi-tenant or modular low-code systems.




Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

description:
About the job

Join a team that puts people at the center of everything. At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it’s about connecting humans with humans. We’re a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




About our partner: Join an adventure-inspired outdoor lifestyle brand that designs quality products to help people make the most of their time outdoors. This adventure-driven lifestyle brand designs premium, purpose-built outdoor gear that turns beaches, campsites, tailgates, and backyard bonfires into unforgettable memories. If you live for the outdoors and want your creative work to fuel that same spirit in others, this is your kind of team.




About the role: This isn't a "wear ten hats" marketing role — it's a chance to go deep on craft. We're looking for a true creative powerhouse: someone who lives at the intersection of graphic design and video editing and can turn raw ideas into scroll-stopping content, fast.

You'll own the visual output for ads, social, and wholesale — designing, editing, and shipping high-quality creative independently, without waiting on approvals to move. Think punchy video edits, eye-catching graphics, and content that actually looks and feels like the outdoors it's selling.




Social media is part of your world too, but on the execution side: you'll build the assets, keep the feed fresh with daily posting, and stay plugged into trends — while someone else handles the strategy.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company—fully remote.







What You'll Do




Creative Production — Priority Focus

Graphic design: Create high-quality graphic assets, GIFs, and short-form ads for social and paid media—plus brand and campaign design as needed.
Video editing: Edit and repurpose a large library of raw footage into short-form ads, social clips, and lifestyle-driven creative for both paid and organic channels.
Content creation: Develop visually engaging, on-brand organic content that maximizes engagement and elevates the company’s visual identity.
Wholesale & channel support: Produce graphics to support the wholesale channel—in-store marketing, seasonal magazines, line sheets, and graphic support for Elastic.

Social Media — Posting & Trend Pulse (not strategy)

Daily posting: Build the assets and post consistently across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube, keeping a steady brand voice.
Trend awareness: Keep a pulse on short-form trends and competitor activity so the company's content stays fresh and relevant.
Community management: Manage comments and DMs—respond where appropriate, reroute conversations from public feeds into DMs, remove/clean up as needed, and escalate customer-service inquiries to the right team member.

Marketing Execution & Support

Campaign support: Help execute product launches, seasonal campaigns, and influencer / ambassador initiatives with the creative assets they need.
Reporting: Work with Marketing Ops, the CEO, and outside agencies to track performance and turn insights into stronger future creative.
Light email & copy support: Occasionally help format newsletters/email flows and provide light copy support (secondary to creative work).







What You Bring




Graphic design: Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma
Video editing: Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, or equivalent.
A true creator: A portfolio of design and video work—ad-ready examples are a big plus.
Experience: 2+ years in a creative or content-focused role, ideally at a DTC, outdoor, or lifestyle brand.
Social fluency: Comfortable posting to social and reading short-form content trends—without needing to own strategy.
Self-starter: Able to prioritize and execute in a fast-moving, small-team environment, and open to wearing different hats.
Nice to Have:
Experience working with outdoor brands
A genuine love for the outdoors and interest in growing your creative scope as the brand scales.







Salary & Perks




Competitive Pay: We hire top talent and compensate accordingly.
This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow
The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with TLNT.
100% remote — work from wherever you do your best thinking
Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (+/- 1 hour accepted) - PST.
Additional perks.







Ready to apply? We'd love to hear your story. The next step is a short application where you can share more about your background and upload your resume in English. Take your time — we read every response carefully.

description:
About the job

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About The Role
We're looking for a hands-on, customer-empathetic Credit Supervisor to own credit management, credit limit increases (CLI), and collections for our Mexico Credit Card. This is a founding role: you will build these frameworks and processes from the ground up.

The Lenda credit card is a mobile app–first product targeted at the credit builder segment in Mexico. We empower customers to access the formal financial ecosystem and build their credit profile over time, while offering a flexible and responsible line of credit tailored to their needs.

What makes this role different from a traditional credit management role is that you think about the customer experience as a credit lever. In a mobile-first, credit builder product, how customers experience the card — activation flows, payment reminders, limit increase offers — directly drives delinquency and engagement. You will work closely with Product and Operations to ensure the customer journey and credit performance reinforce each other.

We are looking for builders and doers that get things done.
In practice, this means being equally comfortable:


Defining and managing CLI eligibility, timing, and quality assurance
Designing collections strategies that balance recovery with customer empathy
Diving into portfolio metrics, roll rates, and delinquency trends
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows that influence credit behavior
Coordinating with Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Customer Support
Driving operational excellence and automation within credit management processes
Having a deep understanding of how post-acquisition performance impacts our P&L


What You'll Be Responsible For
This role will cover all aspects of credit management and collections for our Mexico Credit Card, including:


Owning portfolio performance post-acquisition: delinquency rates, roll rates, loss curves, profitability
Designing and continuously improving the CLI framework — eligibility, timing, sizing, and quality assurance
Building and leading the collections strategy: early-stage treatments, communication flows, escalation paths, recovery rates
Monitoring management KPIs: DPD buckets, NPL rates, recovery rates, CLI uptake and performance
Identifying behavioral signals that predict delinquency and building proactive intervention strategies
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows (payment reminders, activation nudges, CLI offers) that influence credit behavior
Supporting customers experiencing financial difficulty with responsible, empathy-driven solutions
Working with Data Science to build and refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Ensuring compliance with Mexican financial regulations for collections and customer treatment
Improving operational efficiency through automation and tooling


You will have the freedom and responsibility to shape how credit is managed in Mexico from the ground up.

How You'll Work
Credit leaders at Lendable work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Growth to ensure strong portfolio health and sustainable expansion.

It's your job to:


Connect customer behavior patterns to portfolio risk outcomes
Prioritize interventions based on impact on delinquency and profitability
Balance commercial objectives with fair, empathy-driven customer outcomes
Experiment with new collections treatments, measure, and iterate quickly


We encourage all our teams to think big, act fast, and continuously improve.

Experience
You have a solid background in credit management, collections, or consumer lending. You're hands-on, customer-centric, and comfortable moving between strategy, execution, and analysis. Ideally, you bring:


Proficiency in English and Spanish
Solid understanding of credit management fundamentals: delinquency curves, roll rates, vintage analysis, recovery rates, P&L impact of collections
Experience in credit card or consumer lending portfolio management
Experience designing or managing collections strategies (early, mid, and late stage)
Comfort with SQL — you can independently query portfolio data to monitor performance and investigate anomalies
Experience leveraging AI tools to run analyses and drive faster decisions
Strong customer empathy — you understand that collections is a customer experience problem, not just a financial one
Good at communicating to different stakeholders
Strong ownership mentality and accountability for portfolio performance
Agency: you move fast, iterate based on feedback, and proactively flag issues before they escalate
Bonus: Experience thinking about UX or customer journey in the context of credit outcomes (activation, payment behavior, engagement)
Bonus: Experience in credit builder, thin-file, or underbanked segments
Bonus: Some experience on Fraud (especially first-party fraud in collections contexts)
Bonus: Experience in start-up/scale-up environments, credit cards, or fintech
Bonus: Familiarity with Mexican financial regulations for collections (CONDUSEF, CNBV)


The type of work you'll be doing

Own and drive credit management performance, strategy, and execution
Define and monitor KPIs related to delinquency, collections, CLI performance, and profitability
Lead CLI quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives
Design and iterate on collections communication flows and treatment strategies
Collaborate with Data Science to refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Develop internal credit monitoring dashboards and reporting frameworks
Liaise with Product to improve customer-facing flows that influence payment behavior and engagement
Liaise with Operations and Customer Support to ensure smooth credit and collections workflows
Build internal tools to automate manual work and make processes more efficient
Contribute to credit committee discussions and risk governance
Champion data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterating quickly based on learnings
Navigate a fast-paced, evolving fintech landscape, balancing innovation with compliance and risk management


How you will contribute to the Credit Team's objectives


Autonomy: You're comfortable owning and managing the entire credit management line with minimal oversight.
Agency: You proactively find things to implement and improve.
Prioritisation: You independently prioritise and ruthlessly focus on what drives the most impact.
Accountability: You ensure portfolio health and collections performance remain strong as we scale.
Decision-Making: You balance growth and prudence in a fast-paced environment.
Collaboration: You work closely with stakeholders across product, data science, operations, and customer service, quickly assembling cross-functional teams to deliver.
Problem Solving: You break down complex business problems into manageable parts and consistently find practical solutions.
Analysis: You're highly comfortable with numbers, using SQL and analytics tools to turn data into real-world actions.
Communication: You communicate clearly and adapt your style to suit any audience, from engineers to executives — and you're humble enough to change your mind when presented with a better idea.
Creative Mindset: You are open to doing things in a new, better way.
Agility: You thrive in an evolving fintech environment with high ownership and responsibility. You adapt quickly in an unstructured, fast-moving, and constantly evolving environment.


Location

In office in Mexico City
Under very special cases this could be remote. Although frequent presence in the Mexico City office would be required.


Life at Lendable

Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

description:
About the job

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - Commercial and Operations

__


What We Believe In

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your Role: Own the Challenge

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be working on the sales of High Power Rectifier Systems (HPR) services and upgrades for the Metals and Power Conversion Team within North America. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

A Service Sales Support Specialist is the backbone of service sales. While working in close collaboration with the responsible sales Manager, he is the creative mind behind the solution being sold, may that be a simple preventive maintenance or a more complex control upgrade for a full system. He is the one proposing and working out the technical solution and the one who will provide the technical expertise and support required for the sale.

He will work with limited supervision with customer accounts and while also being able to directly discuss technical requirements, he will develop solutions with customers to tremendously improve the buy in into and to increase the trust level aimed at developing a long-term relationship.

It also maintains close business relationships with customers, alerting them of new developments or products and assisting in resolving problems.

The work model for the role is:

This role is contributing to the Metals and Power Conversion team with the Automation - Process Industry Division in North America.

You will be mainly accountable for:


Understanding the customer’s requests for support and translating them into an optimal technical and commercial solution.
Preparing the proposal for the services to be offered to customers by doing basic engineering and by working with all supporting functions including engineering, supply chain, HSE, and contract management departments and even main suppliers.
Communicating and negotiating in collaboration with the sales manager responsible with the customers on commercial aspects of the proposal such as payments, warranty, prices, and general terms and conditions, in line with ABB’s offering and strategy.
Managing administrative procedures in sales processes and project management activities, when needed.
Coordinating activities with customer and project management.


Our team dynamics

You will join a highly skilled, fast-moving, proactive team, where you will be able to thrive. A team driven by curiosity and that strives to find the best technical and commercial solution for our customers. A team that is not afraid of taking on challenges and to innovate. A team with a strong “can do” attitude that always acts with integrity and follows the health and safety guidelines.


Qualifications For The Role


Ability to demonstrate your experience in basic electrical engineering. You have worked at least 5 years in an industrial environment with 3+ years of experience in and working knowledge of electrical engineering applied to Power Converters and Electrical Distribution.
Experience with Variable Frequency Drives and Power Converters will be an advantage.
Experience and working knowledge with High Power Rectifier systems will be a strong asset.
You are passionate about your work and interested in finding optimal solutions. You are captivated by actively listening to customers and understanding their problems and you take it as a personal challenge to find the best solution by collaborating with and coordinating engineering, supply chain, contract manager, and logistic resources to create an optimal solution.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related
You are at ease communicating in English 
Ability to travel if required in the United States and Canada



Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


Performance Bonus
Saving fund
Paid parental leave
Life insurance
Retirement plan
Health and dental insurance
Wellbeing program
Flex days
Employee Assistance Program (PAE)
Access to development platforms: Spark, Harvard Manager Mentor and English Learning EF English Live School (EF)



What's In It For You

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the world.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

description:
About the job

SOMOS LIDERAZGO CON CONCIENCIA

En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. Esto es posible a través de los productos innovadores de Natura y Avon; las experiencias memorables de los servicios de belleza de Bluma y nuestra plataforma de educación financiera, Emana Pay. Marcas y servicios relevantes para quienes los utilizan y reconocidos por nuestro compromiso con la conducción de negocios regenerativos.

Ocupación

Permanente

¿Qué harás aquí?

Responsable de acompañar toda la experiencia de la Fuerza de Venta: Líderes, Gerentes de negocio y Gerentes de ventas de Natura, comprender mejor sus necesidades utilizando diferentes fuentes de investigación: encuestas, focus group, salidas a campo, etc. y utilizar estos datos para optimizar los procesos y actuar como un puente entre el equipo de ventas y todas las áreas de interfase.

¿Qué conocimientos y experiencias necesitarás traer para compartir con nuestra red?


 Análisis de Datos y Comportamiento de los públicos


Mapeo de la Jornada de los públicos de la Fuerza de ventas (Líder de negocio, gerente de negocio y gerente de ventas) identificando los puntos de contacto clave y las áreas de oportunidad para mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

Generar insights: Detectar insights de los datos obtenidos de diversas fuentes (CRM, encuestas, interacciones, visitas a campo, focus group, etc.) para entender el comportamiento, las necesidades y preferencias de los públicos en cada etapa de su Jornada.

Gestión de performance (KPIs).


Desarrollo de Estrategias y Herramientas de Venta:


Optimización de Procesos: Identificar y optimizar los procesos de venta para mejorar la eficiencia del equipo y la experiencia del cliente.

Desarrollo de Contenido: Colaborar en la creación de contenido relevante y personalizado para cada etapa de la jornada del cliente.

Selección de Herramientas: Evaluar y seleccionar herramientas de ventas (automatización de procesos) que faciliten la gestión de clientes y el seguimiento de la jornada.

Responsable de la etapa de crecimiento y retención de la jornada de la Fuerza de ventas (líder de negocios/Gerente de negocios y Gerente de Ventas).

title: Data Analyst - Identity Resolution
skills: Análisis y Exploración: Realizar análisis exploratorios y descriptivos sobre grandes volúmenes de datos, identificando patrones, anomalías y oportunidades de negocio.

Pipeline de Identidad: Perfilar la calidad de atributos de identidad (nombre, email, teléfono, dirección) midiendo completitud, unicidad y consistencia. Monitorear KPIs críticos como match rate, tasa de duplicados, cobertura del Golden Record y falsos positivos.
Automatización: Desarrollar y mantener procesos automatizados en Python aplicando buenas prácticas de código (modularidad, documentación, eficiencia).

Soporte a Machine Learning: Apoyar el tracking y seguimiento del entrenamiento de modelos de ML, registrando métricas y resultados de experimentos, y aplicando pruebas estadísticas para validar hipótesis.
Visualización: Crear y mantener visualizaciones en herramientas de tableros productivos (Power BI, QuickSight) para el seguimiento de KPIs.
Traducción Dato-Decisión: Convertir hallazgos técnicos en información accionable para las áreas de negocio, gestionando correctamente los SLAs (compromisos de entrega y calidad) de los datos.
Experiencia: 3 a 5 años en roles de Data Analyst o Analista de Datos manejando grandes volúmenes de información.
Educación: Licenciatura (titulado o en proceso) en Ciencia de Datos, Inteligencia Artificial, Actuaría o Ingeniería en Sistemas Computacionales.

Identity Resolution: Conocimiento conceptual y práctico comprobable en Identity Resolution y Golden Record (estrategias de matching determinístico y probabilístico, deduplicación y consolidación de perfiles).
Hard Skills:
Desarrollo sólido en Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, SQLAlchemy).
Consultas SQL avanzadas y bases de datos (PostgreSQL, Athena, MySQL, Redshift).
Pensamiento lógico-matemático (álgebra lineal, probabilidad, optimización).
Control de versiones (Git) y buenas prácticas computacionales.
Experiencia en proyectos de analytics en industrias de consumo masivo, loyalty o fintech con identidades de clientes fragmentadas.
Manejo de herramientas Big Data y ML: Spark, AWS S3, MLflow, SageMaker.
Conocimiento en librerías específicas de identidad como AWS Entity Resolution, Splink, rapidfuzz o jellyfish.
Conocimientos de IA Generativa y Agentes de IA.
Programación básica en R.

description:
About the job

¡Bienvenido a The Palace Company!




The Palace Company se distingue en el ámbito de la hospitalidad de lujo por ofrecer experiencias incomparables a través de nuestros exclusivos hoteles, resorts y clubes vacacionales a nivel internacional. Impulsados por una profunda pasión por el servicio, nos dedicamos a crear momentos inolvidables para nuestros huéspedes, cada uno de ellos diseñado con esmero y sofisticación.




Con una trayectoria que se remonta a más de 40 años, somos pioneros en la creación de vacaciones de lujo, marcando un antes y un después en la industria. Nuestra presencia abarca México, Jamaica, Italia y Maldivas, con 17 hoteles de categoría mundial, una planta de alimentos, un exclusivo club vacacional Palace Elite, una agencia digital In House, y tres oficinas corporativas. Además, contamos con cinco divisiones estratégicas que abarcan Operaciones, Tecnología y Producto, Comercial, Inmobiliaria y Finanzas y Administración.




Con más de 14,000 colaboradores comprometidos y apasionados por ofrecer lo mejor, nos enorgullece proporcionar excelencia y calidad en cada aspecto de nuestro trabajo, siempre superando las expectativas de quienes confían en nosotros.




Corporativo Mérida




En la vibrante ciudad de Mérida, Yucatán, se encuentran nuestras oficinas corporativas, un edificio de alta tecnología ubicado en la mejor zona de la ciudad, con acceso directo a una de sus plazas más icónicas, que ofrece una variedad gastronomía y entretenimiento de lujo. Nuestro complejo corporativo, de 13 pisos, ofrece vistas panorámicas excepcionales de la ciudad, así como espacios únicos de trabajo que incluyen salas de videoconferencia, comedores modernos, cocinetas equipadas y amplias zonas de colaboración diseñadas para fomentar la creatividad y productividad de nuestro equipo.




Palace Elite




En The Palace Company, Palace Elite representa el núcleo de nuestra estrategia de ventas. Cada membresía no solo promete un viaje inolvidable, sino que también brinda acceso a un servicio de lujo y amenidades exclusivas, diseñadas para ofrecer un estilo de vida verdaderamente excepcional. Nos enfocamos en superar expectativas en cada detalle, creando momentos únicos que marcan la diferencia y elevan la experiencia a un nivel incomparable.




Tu Oportunidad




Como Agente de Member Services, serás un punto clave en la experiencia de nuestros socios Palace Elite, brindando atención integral a los socios de Palace Elite mediante la gestión oportuna de solicitudes relacionadas con su membresía y reservaciones, asegurando la continuidad de cada caso, el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio y una experiencia excepcional que fortalezca la satisfacción y fidelización de nuestros socios.




Principales responsabilidades

- Atender en tiempo y forma las solicitudes de socios y de las diferentes áreas relacionadas con reservaciones confirmadas y servicios asociados a la membresía.

- Dar seguimiento puntual a casos mediante llamadas, correos electrónicos y actividades administrativas, garantizando su correcta resolución.

- Cumplir con los indicadores de desempeño y estándares de calidad establecidos (AHT, SLA, CSAT y KPIs del área).

- Escalar incidencias cuando sea necesario, asegurando una comunicación clara, oportuna y efectiva con las áreas involucradas.

- Registrar y dar seguimiento a las interacciones y solicitudes mediante herramientas tecnológicas y CRM.

- Apoyar en actividades administrativas relacionadas con la atención y gestión de solicitudes de los socios.




Requisitos

- Licenciatura en Administración, Turismo o carrera afín.

- Portugués indispensable avanzado para la posición.

- Inglés intermedio-avanzado (B2+)

- Mínimo 1 año de experiencia en atención a clientes, customer service, hospitalidad, call center, member services o áreas similares.

- Manejo de Microsoft Office.

Job Title: Outbound Cold Caller

Overview

Are you confident on the phone, motivated by connecting with people, and energized by turning conversations into opportunities? If you thrive on challenges and aren't afraid of hearing "no," this could be the perfect role for you.




Join a growing logistics and freight forwarding company specializing in air cargo transportation and freight coordination. As the company continues to expand its client base and strengthen business relationships, it's looking for a driven and resilient professional to help introduce its services to prospective customers.




As an Outbound Cold Caller, you'll be the first point of contact for potential business clients, playing a key role in generating new opportunities and supporting the sales team. This role is ideal for someone with a positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the determination to succeed. Whether you're just starting your career or already have sales experience, you'll receive the training and support needed to grow.




Key Responsibilities

Make high-volume outbound cold calls to prospective business clients and leads.
Introduce the company's logistics and freight forwarding services using provided scripts and guidelines.
Qualify potential leads by asking key questions about their shipping and freight needs.
Schedule discovery calls and follow-up meetings for the sales and account management team.
Accurately document call outcomes, contact details, and notes in the CRM or Excel spreadsheets.
Send professional follow-up emails after customer conversations.
Handle initial objections professionally while maintaining a positive, customer-focused approach.
Meet or exceed daily and weekly activity goals, including calls made, qualified leads, and appointments booked.




Must-Have Requirements

Entry-level candidates are welcome—prior sales experience is not required if you have the drive and willingness to learn.
Fluent English (spoken and written) with clear pronunciation and strong conversational confidence.
Spanish fluency is a strong advantage.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills with a high-energy, positive attitude.
Resilient, target-driven mindset with the ability to handle rejection professionally.
Basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, and general computer navigation.
Reliable high-speed internet connection, quiet home office, and a quality headset with a microphone.
Availability to work full-time hours aligned with U.S. business hours.




Nice-to-Have Requirements

Previous experience in telemarketing, outbound sales, or customer service.
Familiarity with CRM systems or outbound dialing software.
General knowledge of or interest in the logistics and transportation industry.
Previous remote work experience.




Why Join Us

This is a great opportunity to build a career with a growing logistics company that values attitude, determination, and potential just as much as experience. You'll receive the training, guidance, and support needed to develop your sales skills while working alongside a collaborative remote team.




If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, embraces new challenges, and wants to grow in a fast-paced industry, you'll have the chance to make a real impact while developing valuable experience in business development and logistics.

Graduate/Post-Graduate, major in Medical Laboratory Technology or related.

Profession

Relevant Professional Category

2 or more years of clinical application experience in IVD products (CLIA, Biochemistry) companies or their distributors, or with clinical laboratory working experience. Be familiar with IVD products detection principles, testing process and application service activities.

Experienced in on-site technical support, such as troubleshooting，performance verification.

Language Skill

With customer management and distributor management experience is preferred.

Familiar with Computer and Office Software ( Word, Excel and PPT)

Post-Sale Support

Customer Management

Have a close watch of competitor’s application service activities, make sure our application service is equal or better than theirs.
